'''Gray''' can refer to the following:

* [[Gray Ajah]] - [[Aes Sedai]] dedicated to politics and mediation.
* [[Gray fennel]] - a fast-acting [[herb]] used by assassins.
* ''[[Gray Gull]]'' - a river ship owned by [[Huan Mallia]].
* [[Gray Man]] - a type of [[Shadowspawn]].
* ''[[The Dragon Reborn/Chapter 15|The Gray Man]]'' - the fifteenth chapter of ''[[The Dragon Reborn]]''.
